title: Coherent derived comparison of the source singles
statement: Fix derived localizations [def-pc-derived-category] and a scheme $W$ [def-pc-scheme]. Let $A_t$, $u:A_{t\prime}\cong i^*A_t$, and $\eta_i$ be as in [def-sc-picard-termwise-models]. There are isomorphisms $a_t:Lt^*(\mathcal O_W[0])\cong Q A_t$ for every $t:T\to W$. For every $i:T\prime\to T$ and equality $i;t=t\prime$, with the pinned derived composition comparison $c:Li^*Lt^*\cong Lt\prime^*$ [lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-pullback-composition], they satisfy $a_{t\prime}.\mathrm{hom};Q(u.\mathrm{hom})=c.\mathrm{inv}(\mathcal O_W[0]);Li^*(a_t.\mathrm{hom});\eta_i(A_t)$. This assertion involves neither a perfect model nor a chain map. Derived pullback is that of [def-pc-derived-pullback].

proof.text: Construct α_t from canonicalSinglePullbackMap followed by the single of the inverse tensor-to-ordinary adjunction comparison. The structure sheaf is invertible, so the existing canonicalSinglePullbackMap invertibility theorem shows α_t is invertible. Define a_t=asIso α_t. No object or map is chosen from mere existence.

Apply the canonical termwise single-map composition equation at the structure sheaf. Precompose both sides with c.inv; the inverse-hom identity cancels c.hom and gives the required coherence. The source restriction is definitionally the stated single-map composite.

proof_origin.description: Constructed the canonical comparison using the existing invertible-module single theorem; reduced only the map-level composition calculation, for arbitrary modules, to a new node. This is a decomposition, not a net reduction of holes.

lean.statement:
theorem picard_termwise_source_coherence (W : Scheme.{v}) :
    ∃ a : ∀ {T : Scheme.{v}} (t : T ⟶ W),
        (derivedPullback t).obj ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings W.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj
            (SheafOfModules.unit (moduleRings W.toRingedSpace))) ≅
          DerivedCategory.Q.obj (picardTermwiseSource t),
      ∀ {T T' : Scheme.{v}} (i : T' ⟶ T) (t : T ⟶ W) (t' : T' ⟶ W)
        (ht : i ≫ t = t'),
      let c := (Classical.choose (Classical.choose_spec (Classical.choose_spec
        (Classical.choose_spec exists_derivedPullbackComposition)))) i t ≪≫
          eqToIso (congrArg (fun g : T' ⟶ W ↦ derivedPullback g) ht)
      (a t').hom ≫ DerivedCategory.Q.map (picardTermwiseSourceRestrictionIso i t t' ht).hom =
        c.inv.app _ ≫ (derivedPullback i).map (a t).hom ≫
          (picardTermwiseCounit i).app (picardTermwiseSource t)
